title: Small tools that quietly replace big tech

intro.headline: Small tools. Big replacements.
intro.subhead: Share files between any devices, link your phone to your PC, and stop handing out your real email — all open source, all free.

outro.headline: Three tiny apps, three paid services gone.
outro.subhead: LocalSend, KDE Connect, and SimpleLogin each replace something you used to pay for. Which one are you installing first?
